Tejaswin Shankar Wins Historic Decathlon Bronze Medal

Tejaswin Shankar has won a bronze medal in the men's decathlon at the Commonwealth Games, becoming India's first-ever medallist in the event. Shankar revealed he overcame an injury to achieve this historic feat. The win marks a significant achievement for Indian athletics on the international stage.
